name: Sample Merit Scholarship
description: Financial support for undergraduate students from lower-income households.
benefits: Rs 50000 per year paid in two installments.
eligibility_text: Undergraduate students from families with annual income under the threshold. Applicant must not already hold another central scholarship.
application_process:
Step 1: Register on portal
Step 2: Upload documents
Step 3: Submit before deadline
documents_required:
Aadhaar card
Income certificate
College ID

name: Sample Farmer Support Grant
description: Direct income support for small farmers in Tamil Nadu.
benefits: Rs 6000 per year in three installments.
eligibility_text: Small and marginal farmer families with cultivable landholding in Tamil Nadu.
